title: chore(deps): update zizmorcore/zizmor-action action to v0.7.1
body:
This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Type | Update | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| [zizmorcore/zizmor-action](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action) | action | minor | `v0.6.4` → `v0.7.1` |

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>zizmorcore/zizmor-action</summary>

### [`v0.7.1`](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/releases/tag/v0.7.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1)

### zizmor changes

#### Bug Fixes 🐛🔗

- Fixed a regression in 1.31.0 where some ignore comments/configurations would no longer apply to the dangerous-triggers audit

### action changes

The default version of zizmor is now 1.31.1.

#### What's Changed

- Sync zizmor versions by [@​github-actions](https://redirect.github.com/github-actions)\[bot] in [#​178](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/pull/178)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1>

### [`v0.7.0`](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/releases/tag/v0.7.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/compare/v0.6.4...v0.7.0)

[Sponsorship is appreciated!](https://redirect.github.com/sponsors/woodruffw/)

### zizmor notes

#### Enhancements 🌱[🔗](https://docs.zizmor.sh/release-notes/#enhancements)

- The [typosquat-uses](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#typosquat-uses) audit now supports pre-commit config inputs ([#​2437](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2437))

- The [self-hosted-runner](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#self-hosted-runner) audit is now significantly more precise ([#​2350](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2350))

  Many thanks to [@​ubiratansoares](https://redirect.github.com/ubiratansoares) for proposing and implementing this enhancement!

- The [dangerous-triggers](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#dangerous-triggers) audit now considers the issue_comment trigger fundamentally dangerous ([#​2396](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2396))

- zizmor is now aware of the image_version workflow trigger ([#​2397](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2397))

- The [dangerous-triggers](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#dangerous-triggers) audit now produces more precise finding/diagnostic spans ([#​2402](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2402))

- The [cache-poisoning](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#cache-poisoning) audit is now aware of [pnpm/setup](https://redirect.github.com/pnpm/setup) ([#​2409](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2409))

- The [unpinned-images](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#unpinned-images) audit now produces more precise findings when the user's workflow contains an indirect matrix ([#​2395](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2395))

  Many thanks to [@​ubiratansoares](https://redirect.github.com/ubiratansoares) for proposing and implementing this enhancement!

- The [cache-poisoning](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#cache-poisoning) audit is now aware of GitHub's new cache-mode: setting, and will skip any findings that would occur when a job has an effective cache-mode: none ([#​2418](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2418))

- The [cache-poisoning](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#cache-poisoning) audit now flags usages of cache-mode: write and cache-mode: write-only with dangerous triggers, i.e. triggers that give an attacker privileged code execution ([#​2426](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2426))

- zizmor now uses a tree-sitter grammar for PowerShell that's more precise/capable of capturing more non-trivial PowerShell expressions ([#​2444](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2444))

#### Bug Fixes 🐛[🔗](https://docs.zizmor.sh/release-notes/#bug-fixes)

- Fixed a class of false positives/imprecisions in [adhoc-packages](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#adhoc-packages) that caused some pnpm and yarn invocations to be misclassified as package installations ([#​2386](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2386))

  Many thanks to [@​marcalexiei](https://redirect.github.com/marcalexiei) for implementing this improvement!

- Fixed a bug where zizmor would fail to honor Git submodules and worktrees when discovering configuration files relative to a repo root ([#​2390](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2390))

- Fixed a bug where the [ref-version-mismatch](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#ref-version-mismatch) audit would crash on unusually placed version comments ([#​2394](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2394))

- Fixed a bug where zizmor would fail to handle some pre-commit inputs that use prek extensions to the language_version and default_language_version keys ([#​2413](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2413))

- Fixed a bug where the [use-trusted-publishing](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#use-trusted-publishing) audit would fail to detect certain true-positive patterns inside of PowerShell blocks ([#​2444](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2444))

### action notes

#### What's Changed

- Bootstrap zizmor without Docker by [@​potiuk](https://redirect.github.com/potiuk) in [#​169](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/pull/169)
- Bump sync-zizmor-versions.py to Python 3.11 for locking by [@​woodruffw](https://redirect.github.com/woodruffw) in [#​174](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/pull/174)
- Sync zizmor versions by [@​github-actions](https://redirect.github.com/github-actions)\[bot] in [#​175](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/pull/175)

#### New Contributors

- [@​potiuk](https://redirect.github.com/potiuk) made their first contribution in [#​169](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/pull/169)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/compare/v0.6.4...v0.7.0>

</details>
